semiconductor_relevance: High — GenISys specializes in software solutions for micro- and nano-fabrication processes, particularly in lithography and inspection, which are critical in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: GenISys GmbH develops high-performance software solutions aimed at optimizing micro- and nano-fabrication processes, focusing on lithography and inspection. Their flagship product, BEAMER, enhances productivity and quality in electron- and laser-beam exposure for integrated circuits and MEMS applications.
capabilities: Data preparation and proximity effect correction software for electron- and laser-beam lithography
Advanced layout processing functions for complex curved layouts
Electron-beam simulation of absorbed energy and resist contours
Computational design and process optimization tools

regional_presence.Germany: Headquartered in Munich, Germany, where it develops and markets its software solutions.
regional_presence.Japan: Has a subsidiary in Tokyo, Japan, supporting local market needs.
regional_presence.United States: Operates a subsidiary in San Francisco, California, to cater to the North American market.
